closure_brief.user_intent: Make residual drift coverage and trace-audit closure expectations canonical so future agents cannot close work with orphan warnings.
implemented_changes: Defined residual coverage and classifications in gateway docs.
Documented scoped file-structure cleanup/no mega-task policy.
acceptance_evidence: warning count remains 54 after trimming docs
remaining_risks: Remaining warnings are owned by follow-up SPRINT-023 cleanup tasks.

risks: Future trace-primary source work still needed for trace creation timing; this task documents policy but does not implement trace lifecycle creation source changes.
